# `audio` — Audio round-trip pipeline: CLI reference

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Rendered from the spec registry
> (`geneva_examples/examples/audio/__init__.py`) by `geneva_examples/docs_gen/`;
> regenerate with `make docs`. The same text is shown by `uv run <command> --help`.
> Docs index: [`docs/README.md`](../../README.md).

Seed text prompts, synthesize speech with MMS-TTS, transcribe it back with Whisper, and export the waveforms to .wav — a text -> speech -> text round-trip that runs offline with auto-downloading models.

Order: **ingest-audio -> synthesize-audio -> transcribe-audio -> export-audio**.

**Modality:** `audio` · **Steps in pipeline order:** [`ingest-audio`](#ingest-audio) → [`synthesize-audio`](#synthesize-audio) → [`transcribe-audio`](#transcribe-audio) → [`export-audio`](#export-audio)

## Common options (every command)

Every command below is generated by `geneva_examples/core/spec.py` (`build_command`) and accepts these options in addition to its own:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | `None` | Path to config.yaml (default ./config.yaml). |
| `--mode` | choice: local \| enterprise | `None` | Connection mode: 'local' or 'enterprise'. |
| `--db-uri` | str | `None` | Override the config db_uri (enterprise mode). |
| `--log-level` | str | `INFO` | Logging level. |

A `None` default is resolved at runtime: `--mode` and `--db-uri` follow the config-file precedence, and some model steps resolve `--num-gpus None` to a per-step GPU fraction inside their `run()` (see the step's source file).

## `ingest-audio`

**Ingest text prompts**

Seed an `audio` table with `id` + `text` prompts — the phrases the synthesize step turns into speech. No external media; the pipeline runs fully offline in local mode.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run ingest-audio [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | none |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/audio/ingest.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/audio/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `audio` | Table to operate on. |
| `--frag-size` | int | `1` | Rows per record batch. |
| `--overwrite` / `--no-overwrite` | flag | `--overwrite` | Drop the table first if it already exists. |
| `--table-write-retries` | int | `5` | Retries for create/add ops. |
| `--table-write-retry-sleep-s` | float | `2.0` | Base sleep (s) between table-write retries. |

## `synthesize-audio`

**MMS-TTS speech synthesis**

Backfill an `audio` waveform column (list\<float32\> @ 16 kHz) from `text` using a transformers-native MMS-TTS UDF (facebook/mms-tts-eng). The model auto-downloads to the HF cache on first run — no model files needed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run synthesize-audio [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | yes — runs a model (CPU-only in local mode) |
| Prerequisite | run ingest-audio first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/audio/synthesize.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/audio/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `audio` | Table to operate on. |
| `--input-column` | str | `text` | Column of encoded images. |
| `--output-column` | str | `audio` | Output column name. |
| `--num-cpus` | float | `4.0` | CPUs per task (capped to the machine locally). |
| `--num-gpus` | float | `None` | GPUs per task (forced to 0 locally). |
| `--memory-gib` | int | `4` | Memory (GiB) per task (geneva caps <2). |
| `--checkpoint-size` | int | `32` | Rows per checkpoint / UDF __call__. |
| `--task-size` | int | `32` | Rows per read task. |
| `--concurrency` | int | `16` | Backfill/refresh concurrency (1 locally). |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (minutes). |
| `--flush-interval-s` | float | `30.0` | Checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |
| `--reset` / `--no-reset` | flag | `--no-reset` | Drop and re-synthesize the whole audio column (destructive). Default off = incremental: only synthesize rows still missing it. |

## `transcribe-audio`

**Whisper transcription**

Backfill a `transcript` column by transcribing the synthesized `audio` column with Geneva's shipped WhisperChunkTranscriber (openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo by default, auto-downloads; override with --model-id). Closes the text -> speech -> text round-trip.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run transcribe-audio [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | yes — runs a model (CPU-only in local mode) |
| Prerequisite | run synthesize-audio first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/audio/transcribe.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/audio/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `audio` | Table to operate on. |
| `--input-column` | str | `audio` | Column of encoded images. |
| `--output-column` | str | `transcript` | Output column name. |
| `--model-id` | str | `openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo` | HF ASR checkpoint (e.g. openai/whisper-tiny .. openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo); auto-downloads on first run. |
| `--num-cpus` | float | `4.0` | CPUs per task (capped to the machine locally). |
| `--num-gpus` | float | `None` | GPUs per task (forced to 0 locally). |
| `--memory-gib` | int | `4` | Memory (GiB) per task (geneva caps <2). |
| `--checkpoint-size` | int | `32` | Rows per checkpoint / UDF __call__. |
| `--task-size` | int | `32` | Rows per read task. |
| `--concurrency` | int | `16` | Backfill/refresh concurrency (1 locally). |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (minutes). |
| `--flush-interval-s` | float | `30.0` | Checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |
| `--reset` / `--no-reset` | flag | `--no-reset` | Drop and re-transcribe the whole transcript column (destructive). Default off = incremental: only transcribe rows still missing it. |

## `export-audio`

**Export waveforms to .wav**

Write each row's synthesized `audio` waveform to a 16-bit PCM WAV file under `--out-dir` (default /tmp/geneva_audio), named `<id>.wav`. Runs on the client; needs no extra audio dependency.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run export-audio [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | run synthesize-audio first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/audio/export.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/audio/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `audio` | Table to operate on. |
| `--audio-column` | str | `audio` | Waveform column to export. |
| `--id-column` | str | `id` | Column used for each output filename. |
| `--out-dir` | str | `/tmp/geneva_audio` | Directory to write .wav files into. |
| `--sample-rate` | int | `16000` | WAV sample rate (Hz); MMS-TTS emits 16000. |
| `--limit` | int ≥ 0 | `0` | Max rows to export (0 = all). |
